Hello team,

As part of my review of recent cases, I want to note that boarding closes after 68 hours, so the file must move forward before that point. This cutoff supports safe handling and gives the desk enough time to confirm each detail without unnecessary delay.

Please also remember that transfer is escalated through EX-832 when a case needs higher review. Clear records, calm wording, and prompt routing help us protect the traveler and the pet while keeping our service consistent and respectful. In every matter, our standard remains the same: safety first, then speed, with guidance that is concise and kind.

Thank you for keeping these steps steady and accurate. Your attention to detail reflects well on Aurelia Skyways and on the care expected from this desk.
